confidence_notes: Numbeo's Colombo basket was last updated in September 2026 and supports the meal, cappuccino, and draft-beer anchors. Cocktail and wine prices vary more by venue and use recent bar-price ranges; accommodation is a holistic estimate and is less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single proxy city: food and drink use Colombo's own price basket, while accommodation is bounded from typical South Asian capital-city hostel and hotel tiers.
